suppressedCandidates.decisionReason: The quote contains two compatible frequency quantities, but the pre-fix scalar candidate retained only the first.
The quote contains phase-to-phase and phase-to-neutral quantities, but the pre-fix scalar candidate retained only the first without its condition.

findings.evidence: Two real Trihal lines containing multiple compatible quantities produced scalar candidates that retained only the first quantity and omitted the alternative or dimensional condition.
findings.correction: Require exactly one compatible quantity in the quote before emitting a scalar numeric candidate.

findings.evidence: The bounded pilot could associate files with publisher-domain URLs but had no human acquisition-provenance or authenticity decisions, while the prior intake enum required an official source class.
findings.correction: Represent the pilot inputs as PUBLISHER_DOMAIN_ASSOCIATED_UNREVIEWED and keep authenticityStatus UNREVIEWED.

findings.evidence: Eight machine-accepted documents across both product families produced zero post-fix review-ready candidates against a gate requiring at least 25 total and 10 per family.
findings.proposedCorrection: Make an explicit product decision on a variant-aware table extraction architecture before repeating human candidate review.

findings.evidence: At least six accepted product catalogs place multiple models, ratings, or dimensional contexts in table columns that normalized line text does not represent as structured product-variant associations.
findings.proposedCorrection: Preserve row, column, header, footnote, and product-variant identity in a separately reviewed extraction format; do not infer associations from flattened text.

findings.evidence: Two technical transformer tap-voltage rows were refused because hyphenated voltage sequences matched the Korean phone-number safety pattern.
findings.proposedCorrection: Do not weaken the private-data guard in isolation; distinguish table cells and typed electrical quantities before safety classification.

findings.evidence: All document authenticity, revision-currentness, and redistribution/use judgments remain UNREVIEWED; machine intake acceptance is not a human validity decision.
findings.proposedCorrection: Collect bounded human decisions for each document before any MERGE or authenticity claim.

findings.evidence: One publisher metadata page labeled a Trihal PDF Korean while representative technical pages in the supplied PDF were English.
findings.correction: Refuse the input instead of trusting metadata language.

findings.evidence: Two publisher-hosted switchgear catalogs were 47116934 and 42927512 bytes, above the 25000000-byte source limit.
findings.correction: Refuse the inputs and use bounded smaller publisher documents; do not raise the safety cap without a separate resource analysis.

findings.evidence: The structured reason taxonomy still cannot independently record table, variant, condition-dimension, comparison, tolerance, or duration-semantic loss.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add bounded loss-mode decisions only together with a variant-aware evidence architecture and human review protocol.

fixes.result: The two partial scalar candidates are no longer emitted; distinct quantities with different unit kinds remain extractable.
Real pilot bundles use a neutral publisher-domain-associated class and retain explicit UNREVIEWED authenticity.

inputBlockers.evidence: No candidate review decision, review duration, usefulness result, or patch-suitability judgment was supplied.
Authenticity, currentness, and redistribution/use remain UNREVIEWED for every evaluated input.
